text: Welcome.
Take a breath, just as you are.
Let this be a moment just for you.
A moment to set down the weight of the day, the noise of the world.
A moment to come home to your own heart.
Along the way, I'll give you a few words to say to yourself.
Notice the soft rhythm of your breath.
The way it moves through you without effort.
Inhale deeply, filling your body with warmth.
And exhale slowly, letting something inside you soften.
There is a place inside of you where love already lives.
A place where you are already whole.
Already worthy. Already loved.
This is not something you have to earn.
It's something you relax into. Something you allow.
Imagine now a soft golden warmth glowing in your chest.
Gentle, and steady.
This is the energy of love.
And it isn't only inside you. It's all around you, too.
Let it come in with every inhale.
Let it settle with every exhale.
Let it move through you.
Softening your shoulders, your face, the space behind your eyes.
If any old stories rise up, just notice them.
No need to hold on. No need to push them away.
Just let them drift, like leaves floating downstream.
With each breath you feel warmer, softer, more open.
Now say these to yourself, silently.
I am worthy of love, exactly as I am.
Love flows to me, and love flows through me.
I am open to being loved.
And as that warmth grows, let it spread beyond you.
The love inside you is not a limited thing.
The more it flows, the more there is.
Take a slow, easy breath in.
And exhale fully.
When you are ready, begin to bring a little movement back into your body.
And whenever it feels right, let your eyes open.
Carry this warmth with you.
It was always yours.
